6775.title: ACP completion infers success from unfinished tool work
6775.rootCauseOneLine: Non-cancellation completion closes unfinished tools as completed and promotes their last content into results; Kimi's actual ACP failure signal remains unverified.
6775.proposedFix: Capture an isolated Kimi ACP failure before choosing a narrow failure mapping or provider propagation repair; do not infer an error from progress content alone.
6775.caveats: Two clean same-agent reproductions verify bridge behavior only. No live Kimi plan-state failure or actual failing ACP response was captured. Synthetic failed/error stop reasons are hypotheses, not claimed standard ACP values. No production fix or PR was safe without that boundary evidence.
